subject.title: Fix stale session routes for removed providers

question: Should OpenClaw treat persisted session provider/model refs that are absent from current config/catalog as invalid and fall back to the configured default at chat-send time?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow bug fix, but the behavior change is intentional upgrade-visible provider/auth routing for existing persisted sessions.

options.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
options.body: Merge this PR once maintainers agree that removed or catalog-invisible persisted routes should no longer win at runtime.

options.title: Require stricter stale-route handling
options.body: Ask for fail-closed or diagnostic behavior when catalog loading fails if preserving unknown merge-mode routes is too permissive.

options.title: Split persistent cleanup explicitly
options.body: Land the runtime guard only if doctor warnings, migration, and reset commands are accepted as follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
recommendation.body: Merge this PR once maintainers agree that removed or catalog-invisible persisted routes should no longer win at runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/runtime policy choice over upgrade behavior, and `steipete` is both a recent area contributor and the listed project decision owner.
